title: At the edge point a of a planar sector every tangent cone is ±m[[Q]], and spt C lies in a cusp around Q near a
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and C ∈ 𝒟_2(ℝ^P) be minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn C univ), with ∂C = 0 and a cone (IsConeCurrent C). Let Q be a 2-dimensional linear subspace of ℝ^P, a, e ∈ Q with |a| = |e| = 1 and ⟨a, e⟩ = 0, δ > 0 and k ∈ ℕ with k ≥ 1. Assume a ∈ spt C and that for all t > 0 and φ ∈ (0, δ) the point y := t(cos φ·a + sin φ·e) satisfies HasMassDensity C y k and spt C ∩ B_r(y) ⊆ Q for some r > 0. Then there is m ∈ ℕ with m ≥ 1 and HasMassDensity C a m such that: (1) for every sequence λ_j > 0 with λ_j → 0 there are a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ, C' ∈ 𝒟_2(ℝ^P) and c ∈ ℤ with |c| = m such that blowUp C a λ_{φ(j)} ⇀ C' (ConvergesWeakly), C'(ω) = c·∫_Q ω(x)(a, e) dH²(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟²(ℝ^P) (H² = μHE[2], ω(x)(a, e) = ω(x) applied to ![a, e]), and, for every integer multiplicity representation R of C and every continuous compactly supported g : ℝ^P → ℝ, λ_{φ(j)}^{−2}·∫ g(η_j(x)) dR.measure(x) → m·∫_Q g dH², where η_j := dilation a λ_{φ(j)} (η_j(x) = λ_{φ(j)}^{−1}(x − a)); and (2) there is s₀ with 0 < s₀ ≤ 1/4 such that for every s' ∈ (0, s₀] and every x ∈ spt C with ⟨x, a⟩ > 0, ||x| − 1| < s', |arctan(⟨x, e⟩/⟨x, a⟩)| < s' and |x − πx| ≤ 2s₀|x| (π := Q.starProjection) one has |x − πx| < (s'/4)|x| and |x − a| < 3s'.
